name: ui-layouts-color-picker
blurb: Hex color picker in a popover with input field and copy button.
description: A controlled color picker component using HexColorPicker that opens in a popover, with direct hex input, copy-to-clipboard, and optional eyedropper tool support.
use_when: Building design tools, theme editors, or settings pages where users need to pick and manage custom colors.
avoid_when: When the native HTML color input suffices or eyedropper support isn't required.
a11y: Buttons have sr-only labels, label connects to the trigger button, focus is managed within the popover.
